reading.body:
Tecnodati S.R.L. is an unverified OpenStreetMap record, not a confirmed data center, and it carries no power figure at all.

The record is tagged telecom=data_center and named with the Italian word for data plus the standard S.R.L. company suffix. That naming is on-theme for a small Italian IT or data-services business, which makes it more plausible than other Italian entries in the same dataset whose names point to accounting, foam manufacturing, or auto clubs. The coordinates place it near Parma, about 18.6 miles from Parma Airport.

The zero megawatt value is the important part. It is not a measurement of a facility drawing no power, it is the absence of any capacity data, so nothing here can be compared against the grid or against other sites. A name and a map tag are not evidence of servers, cooling, or a grid connection.

What this does not tell a reader is whether a data center exists at this location at all. No operator website, press coverage, or Italian business registration was confirmed, and the research is marked exhausted rather than resolved. Treat it as a lead for verification, not as a node in any compute or power map.
